Rashi on Ketubot 69a:10:1.hebrew: יורשת הויא - עישור נכסים שתקנו לה, בתורת ירושה תקינו לה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:10:1.english: She is an inheritor - The tenth of the property that [the Sages] instituted for her, they instituted it for her as an inheritance.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:10:2.hebrew: אין - באמת לא מצו לסלוקה בזוזי ולא בחדא ארעא, שאם רוצה נוטלת חלקה מכל קרקע וקרקע, ואין יכולין להקנות לה חלקה במקום אחד:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:10:2.english: Yes - Indeed, they cannot remove her with money, nor with a single [parcel of] land; for if she wishes, she takes her share from each and every [parcel of] land, and they cannot assign her her share in one place.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:11:1.english: [She] is a creditor - And [the heir] can pay her off with money or with a single plot of land.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:12:1.hebrew: למיגבא בינונית ושלא בשבועה כו' - אי בעלת חוב דאבא הויא, אינה גובה אלא מן הזיבורית, ואינה נפרעת אלא בשבועה שלא נטלה מנכסים הללו כלום, דקיי"ל (גיטין מח:) אין נפרעין מנכסי יתומים אלא מן הזבורית ואין נפרעים מהן אלא בשבועה. ואי בעלת חוב שלהן, אין כאן בא ליפרע מנכסי יתומין:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:12:1.english: To collect intermediate-quality [land] and without an oath, etc. - If she is a creditor of the father, she collects only from inferior-quality [land], and she is paid only with an oath that she has not taken anything from these properties, as we hold (Gittin 48b) [that] one collects from orphans' property only from inferior-quality [land], and one collects from them only with an oath. And if [she is] a creditor of theirs, there is no one here coming to collect from orphans' property.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:13:1.hebrew: רב אשי מת, ומת רב סמא בנו בחייו. וכשבאת בתו ליפרע, נטלה מחלקו של מר בר רב אשי שהיה קיים בינונית שלא בשבועה, אלמא בעלת חוב דאחי הויא:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:13:1.english: Rav Ashi died, and his son Rav Sama died during [Rav Ashi's] lifetime. And when his daughter came to collect [her share], she took intermediate-quality [land] without an oath from the portion of Mar bar Rav Ashi, who was alive; evidently, she is a creditor of the brothers.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:13:2.hebrew: ומבריה דרב סמא זיבורית - לפי שבעלת חוב של אביו היתה, שהיה אחיה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:13:2.english: And from the son of Rav Sama, inferior-quality land - Because she was his father's creditor, for [his father] was her brother.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:14:1.hebrew: כי אתיא ההיא איתתא - אשה אחת באת לפני ר' נחמיה, שהיה לה ליטול עישור נכסים במקומו של רבה בר רב הונא, ובקשה ממנו לשלוח לו דבר מאתו שישתדל בדינה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:14:1.english: When that woman comes - A certain woman came before Rav Nechemya, who had to collect a tenth of [her father's] estate in the place of Rabbah bar Rav Huna, and she asked him to send word to him from himself so that he would exert himself in her case.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:14:2.hebrew: אצטרובלא - מושב אמת הרחים כמות שהן, ומקרקעי חשיב להו:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:14:2.english: Itzterubela - The seat of the mill-trough as they are, and he considers them real estate.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:14:3.hebrew: מעמלא דביתי - שכירות הבתים, ממקרקעי קא אתי:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:14:3.english: From the earnings of houses - [This refers to] the rent of the houses; it comes from real estate.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:15:1.hebrew: הוה יתיב רב ששת קמיה - כשבא השליח לפניו, ואיקפד רב הונא על דקרייה הונא חברין:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:15:1.english: Rav Sheshet was sitting before him - [That is,] when the messenger came before him, and Rav Huna took offense because [Rav Anan] had called him "Huna, our friend."

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:15:2.hebrew: א"ל - רב הונא לרב ששת:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:15:2.english: He said to him - Rav Huna [said] to Rav Sheshet.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:15:3.english: Go, say to him - In derogatory language, as I will tell you.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:15:4.english: And in excommunication - You shall be if you do not say [it] in this language.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:15:5.hebrew: ענן ענן - מהיכן אתה אומר להגבותה, ממקרקעי או אפילו ממטלטלי? ועוד שאלה אחרת השיבני:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:15:5.english: Anan, Anan - From what [property] do you say to have her collect — from real estate or even from movable property? And furthermore, answer me another question:

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:15:6.hebrew: מאן יתיב בי מרזיחא ברישא - מי מיסב בבית אבל בראש הקרואים? כשהיו מסובים בסעודה, היה ניכר מסיבתן מי הוא הראש, שהגדול מיסב במטה אחת לראש השולחן, ושני לו במטה אחרת למטה הימנו:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:15:6.english: Who sits in the house of a marzeicha at the head - Who reclines in a house of mourning at the head of the invited guests? When they would recline at a meal, it was recognizable from their seating [arrangement] who was the head, for the greatest [among them] would recline on one couch at the head of the table, and the second to him on another couch below him.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:16:1.hebrew: א"ל מר רבה - אתה, ורב הונא רבך. ולפייסו אמר לו כך, שלא יכעוס עליו על שנעשה שליח בדבר, ומראהו פנים שעל כרחו נעשה שליח לכך:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:16:1.english: He said to him, "Master [is] a teacher" - You [are a teacher], and Rav Huna [is] your teacher. And he said this to him in order to appease him, so that he would not be angry with him for having become a messenger in [this] matter, and he shows him that he became a messenger for this against his will.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:1:1.english: Rav attached [a question] for Rabbi between the lines - He sent him a letter of greetings and inserted this question between the lines.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:1:2.hebrew: הוה יתיבי ר' חייא קמיה - דרבי, כשבאת שאלה זו לפניו:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:1:2.english: Rabbi Chiyya was sitting before him - [before] Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], when this question came before him.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:1:3.hebrew: א"ל - רבי חייא: מאי "שיעבדו" דקא מיבעי ליה — מכרו או משכנו:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:1:3.english: He said to him - Rabbi Ḥiyya [said to Rabbi]: What is [the meaning of] "they mortgaged" that he [Rav] is asking about — [did] they sell or [did] they pledge [the property]?

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:4:1.hebrew: דמשמע הכי ומשמע הכי - והוא כשישיב תשובתו, יפרש אם שניהם שוים לו, או (אם) יש חילוק ביניהן, ומהו אומר על שניהם:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:4:1.english: Which implies this and implies that - And he, when he sends back his reply, will clarify whether both [cases] are equal to him, or whether there is a distinction between them, and what he says regarding both of them.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:5:1.english: Whether [it is] this or whether [it is] that, [the court] does not appropriate - Both for dowry and for sustenance.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:6:1.english: Until the son died - and the inheritance fell to the daughters.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:7:1.hebrew: ויתרה - עישור נכסים. ולא אמרי' תיטול עישור נכסים תחלה כמו שנטלה זו ואח"כ יחלוקו, אלא זו שקדמה ונשאת זכתה. ובת על הבת אין לה עישור נכסים, שהרי שתיהן שוות בירושה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:7:1.english: She forfeited - [Her] tenth of the estate. And we do not say [that] she should take a tenth of the estate first, just as this [first sister] took, and afterward they divide [the remainder]; rather, the one who married earlier acquired [it], and a daughter does not have [a claim to] a tenth of the estate against [another] daughter, since both of them are equal in inheritance.

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:7:2.hebrew: גדולה מזו - שאפילו שיעבדו אחין את הנכסים, יפה כח פרנסה לטרוף לקוחות; וזו שהנכסים בעין, אמרת ויתרה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:7:2.english: Greater than this - For even if [the] brothers encumbered the properties, the power of dowry is strong [enough] to seize [property from] purchasers; and [yet regarding] this one, where the properties are [still] intact, you say [that] she forfeited?

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:8:1.hebrew: נימא ליה מאן אמרה - אלא לאו שמיע ליה ולא קבלה, ומשום הכי לא הדר נמי מהא דשתי בנות וכו':
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:8:1.english: Let him say to him, "Who stated it?" - Rather, [is it] not [that] he heard it and did not accept it, and because of this he also did not retract from that [case] of two daughters, etc.?

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:8:2.hebrew: לעולם לא הוה שמיע ליה - מעיקרא, וכי שמעה — קיבלה. וכי אותביה ר' חנינא, כבר הוה שמיע ליה וקיבלה, ומש"ה לא א"ל מאן אמרה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:8:2.english: Actually, he had not heard it - initially, and when he heard it, he accepted it. And when Rabbi Ḥanina challenged him, he had already heard it and accepted it, and therefore he did not say to him, "Who stated that?"

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:8:3.english: And it is different there - [This explains] why he did not retract what he said, [that] the second [daughter] forfeited [her claim].

Rashi on Ketubot 69a:8:4.hebrew: משום רווח ביתא - שהרי נשתכרה הרבה, שנוטלת חצי הירושה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69a:8:4.english: Because of the abundance of the house - For she has profited greatly, as she takes half of the inheritance.

Tosafot on Ketubot 69a:11:1.hebrew: ואישתיק - מכאן רגיל ר"ת, כשהיה יושב בדין ואחד מבעלי דינין מגזם לחברו ואומר: "כך וכך תתחייב לי בדין", רגיל היה ר"ת לומר: "שקר אתה דובר, כי לא יתחייב"; שאם אין לו לדיין לומר כן, מה היה מוכיח רב מניומי מדאשתיק אמימר:
Tosafot on Ketubot 69a:11:1.english: And he was silent - From here Rabbeinu Tam was accustomed [that] when he was sitting in judgment and one of the litigants would threaten his fellow, saying, "You will be found liable to me for such-and-such in court," Rabbeinu Tam was accustomed to say, "You are speaking falsely, for he will not be held liable" — for if a judge did not have to say so, what would Rav Minyumi prove from [the fact] that Ameimar was silent?

Tosafot on Ketubot 69a:14:1.hebrew: מעמלא דביתי - וא"ת היכי דמי? אי בשכירות שיבא מן הבתים — פשיטא שטורפת, דהא מקרקעי אינהו; ואי בשכירות שגבו כבר — הני מטלטלי ממש הוו! ויש לומר דמיירי שהשכירו הבית לשנה ועמד בו השוכר חצי שנה, ואע"ג דכבר נתחייב על מה שעמד בבית, גובה ולא חשיב מטלטלי, דשכירות אינה משתלמת אלא לבסוף:
Tosafot on Ketubot 69a:14:1.english: From the rental income of houses - And if you will ask: What is the case? If [it refers] to rent that will come [in the future] from the houses — it is obvious that she collects [from it], since they are real estate; and if [it refers] to rent that they have already collected — that is actual movable property! And one can say that it is speaking of [a case] where they rented out the house for a year and the tenant lived in it for half a year; and even though he has already become obligated for [the period] that he lived in the house, she collects [from it] and it is not considered movable property, because rent is only payable at the end [of the term].

Tosafot on Ketubot 69a:15:1.hebrew: ובשמתא להוי מאן דלא לימא ליה - וא"ת: אע"פ שא"ל, יהא צריך הפרה, כדאמרינן באלו הן הגולין (מכות דף יא: ושם): "נדוי על תנאי צריך הפרה, מנלן? מיהודה, דכתיב אם לא הביאותיו אליך וגו', אף על פי שקיים התנאי היו עצמותיו מגולגלין בארון"! וי"ל דה"מ בדבר שהמנודה מסופק בשעת הנדוי אם יתקיים התנאי, כי התם, דמאריה וגנבי דבידי שמים לא היה יכול לשומרו, והוי כאילו אין תנאי כלל; אבל הכא, שבידו לקיים התנאי, אין צריך הפרה. ר"ת:
Tosafot on Ketubot 69a:15:1.english: And let whoever does not say to him be in excommunication - And if you ask: Even though he said [it] to him, he should require annulment [of the excommunication], as we say in [the chapter] Eilu Hen HaGolin (Makkot 11b and there): "A conditional excommunication requires annulment; from where do we [derive] this? From Judah, as it is written, 'If I do not bring him to you, etc.' — even though he fulfilled the condition, his bones were rolling about in [his] coffin"! And one can answer that this applies only to a matter where the excommunicated person is uncertain at the time of the excommunication whether the condition will be fulfilled — like there, where he could not guard him from a lion and thieves, which are in the hands of Heaven, and [therefore] it is as though there is no condition at all; but here, where it is in his power to fulfill the condition, he does not require annulment. Rabbeinu Tam.

Tosafot on Ketubot 69a:1:1.hebrew: תלה ליה רב לרבי ביני חטי - פירש ר"ח: שאלות הרבה שאלו, והיו אגרות תפורות זו לזו, ובין אותם תפירות כתב שאלה זו. ובקונטרס פי': "בין השיטין", וכן אמר בירושלמי בהנזקין: "תלי לי ביני שיטיא":
Tosafot on Ketubot 69a:1:1.english: Rav attached [a question] for Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] beini chittei - Rabbeinu Chananel explained: He asked him many questions, and the letters were sewn one to another, and between those seams he wrote this question. And in the Kuntres [Rashi] he explained: "Between the lines." And similarly it says in the Yerushalmi in [Chapter] HaNizakin: "Tali li beini shitaya" [attached for me between the lines].

Tosafot on Ketubot 69a:8:1.hebrew: משום רווח ביתא - יש להסתפק היכא דאיכא עשר בנות, דליכא רווח ביתא, מהו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 69a:8:1.english: Because of the abundance [in] the house - There is room to inquire: where there are ten daughters, such that there is no abundance [in] the house, what is [the law]?
